summary.zh: 收件箱新增只读 check（报告缺条件/目的的候选与 OPINION.md 行）、revise（修订候选并留痕）和机械关系提示（relations，仅供参考）。
summary.en: The inbox gains a read-only check (reports candidates and OPINION.md lines missing a trigger or purpose), revise (edit a candidate with history) and mechanical relation hints (relations, for reference only).
